**Hydrogen – Key Properties**

| Property | Value / Description |
|----------|---------------------|
| **Atomic number** | 1 |
| **Atomic mass** | ~1.008 u (average; 1.00794 u for protium) |
| **Isotopes** | Protium (^1H), Deuterium (^2H), Tritium (^3H) |
| **Electron configuration** | 1s¹ |
| **Electronegativity (Pauling)** | 2.20 |
| **First ionization energy** | 13.598 eV (1312 kJ mol⁻¹) |
| **Electron affinity** | –0.754 eV (–72 kJ mol⁻¹) |
| **Molar mass** | 1.00794 g mol⁻¹ |
| **Standard molar volume (STP)** | 22.414 L mol⁻¹ |
| **Density (STP)** | 0.08988 g cm⁻³ |
| **Melting point** | –259.16 °C (14 K) |
| **Boiling point** | –252.87 °C (20.28 K) |
| **Heat capacity (Cp, 298 K)** | 28.836 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ |
| **Enthalpy of formation (ΔH°f, 298 K)** | 0 kJ mol⁻¹ (by definition for elemental H₂) |
| **Entropy (S°, 298 K)** | 130.68 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ |
| **Gibbs free energy of formation (ΔG°f, 298 K)** | 0 kJ mol⁻¹ (by definition for elemental H₂) |
| **Physical state (STP)** | Colorless, odorless, tasteless gas |
| **Flammability** | Extremely flammable; forms explosive mixtures with air (1–4 % H₂ in air) |
| **Bonding** | Diatomic (H₂) with a single covalent bond; weak van der Waals forces |
| **Reactivity** | Reacts with halogens, oxygen, and many metals; forms hydrides (e.g., NaH, CaH₂) |
| **Role in water** | Combines with oxygen to form H₂O; essential for life and many industrial processes |
| **Applications** | Fuel (hydrogen fuel cells), rocket propellant, ammonia synthesis (Haber process), metal hydride batteries, laboratory reagent |

---

### Quick Takeaways

- **Lightest element**: Hydrogen has the lowest atomic mass and density among all elements.
- **Highly reactive**: Forms compounds with almost every other element; key player in combustion and synthesis reactions.
- **Energy carrier**: Used in fuel cells and as a clean-burning fuel; potential for green energy solutions.
- **Isotopic significance**: Deuterium and tritium are used in nuclear fusion research and as tracers in scientific studies.

Feel free to ask if you’d like more details on any specific property or application!
